children: Melar Acquisition I agreed to domesticate to Nevada and merge Merger Sub into Everli as part of a Business Combination; pro forma equity value shown at $313.0M.
Melar will domesticate from the Cayman Islands to Nevada, then merge its Merger Sub into Everli, leaving Everli as a wholly owned subsidiary.
A Form S-4 registration statement (File No. 333-298505) has been filed, including a proxy statement/prospectus for the transaction.
Investor presentation attached as Exhibit 99.1 details Everli’s Italian grocery marketplace model, metrics and growth plan.
Pro forma valuation (no redemptions scenario) shows 31,295,545 pro forma shares at $10.00 per share, pro forma equity value $313.0M and pro forma enterprise value $243.8M.
Everli reported FY2025 GTV of $77.9M, 769k orders, ~21% take rate and current gross profit margin of ~7% with initiatives to improve margins.
